info.title: MGMD_VGPS
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

excluded_source_count.description: Count of sources requested to be excluded for the group on the port on the VLAN (VGP). Only applicable when source is 0.0.0.0/0::0.  An empty entry indicates a count of 0. The field is not applicable for VLAN, group, port, source (VGPS) entries.

port.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGPS](#/MGMD_VGPS)
The VGPS entries associated with the VGS entry. A VGS entry could have multiple [MGMD_VGPS](#/MGMD_VGPS) references depending on the number of [Port](#/Port) where reports for this VLAN, group, [source] were received.

requested_source_count.description: Count of sources requested to be included for the group on the port on the VLAN (VGP). Only applicable when source is 0.0.0.0/0::0.  An empty entry indicates a count of 0. The field is not applicable for VLAN, group, port, source (VGPS) entries.

state.description: 'include':   Group, port or group, port, source in INCLUDE mode. 'exclude':   Group, port or group, port, source in EXCLUDE mode. 'v1_member': Group, port in v1 compatibility mode. 'v2_member': Group, port in v2 compatibility mode.

timers_absolute.description: Group, port timers or group, port, source timers in seconds added with the system uptime. System uptime is the switch bootup time (number of seconds since bootup). The system uptime is added to the timers so that the timer values don't need to be updated every clock tick.

create_time.description: Time when the VGPS entry was created.

exclude_mode_expiry_time.description: This timer is used when the port on the group is in EXCLUDE mode and when this timer expires, the port will move to INCLUDE mode.

expiry_time.description: Time when the VGPS entry will expire.

older_v1_host_expiry_time.description: Time at which the port on the group will transition back to IGMPv3/IGMPv2. The timer is initiated on receiving an older IGMPv1 report. This timer is applicable only for IGMP.

older_v2_host_expiry_time.description: Time at which the port on the group will transition back to IGMPv3/MLDv2. The timer is initiated on receiving an older IGMPv2/MLDv1 report.

source_expiry_time.description: Expiry time of this source on this port.

version.description: MGMD version for the VLAN, group, port or VLAN, group, port, source. The field is only applicable for a VLAN, group, port entry. For VLAN, group, port, source entries, this field is not applicable and should be left empty.

parameters.name: VLAN.id
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
The ID of this VLAN. Non-internal VLANs must have an 'id' between 1 and 4094 to be effectively instantiated.

parameters.name: MGMD_VGS.mgmd_type
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGS](#/MGMD_VGS)
Type represents whether the entry is for IGMP or MLD.

parameters.name: MGMD_VGS.group_ip
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGS](#/MGMD_VGS)
Multicast group IP address.

parameters.name: MGMD_VGS.source_ip
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGS](#/MGMD_VGS)
Source address from which multicast group traffic is requested to be included or excluded.

parameters.name: MGMD_VGS.filter_type
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [MGMD_VGS](#/MGMD_VGS)
'filter': Group or group, source will be filtered based on multicast group membership. 'filter_additive': Includes the list of user configured forward ports, IGMP querier detected ports and PIM router detected ports in the VLAN. Multicast data packets are always forwarded. 'flood': Group or group, source will be flooded in the VLAN. 'filter_isl': Unknown multicast data packets will be forwarded to port if ISL port is configured.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
